name: Scenario A — Normal Operation
summary: Nominal design head (85 m), rated flow (60 m³/s) near Best Efficiency Point, 85% guide vanes, 40 MW grid demand with healthy reserve margin.

name: Scenario B — Reduced Water Flow
summary: Dry-season / throttled discharge (32 m³/s at 50% wicket gate opening). Demonstrates Francis part-load efficiency drop (~81.3%) and load deficit against 35 MW demand.

name: Scenario C — Reduced Head
summary: Reservoir drawdown lowers net head to 55 m. Even at 85% gate opening, orifice scaling caps actual flow to 49.23 m³/s, cutting electrical generation nearly in half.

name: Scenario D — Efficiency Degradation
summary: Simulates cavitation/seal wear and stator cooling degradation (turbine ref 78%, generator ref 90%) at full 85 m head and 60 m³/s flow, losing >10 MW to losses.

name: Scenario E — Load Variation (High Demand)
summary: Grid demand rises to 48 MW while hydraulic conditions remain nominal. Synchronous rotor speed remains locked at 250 rpm while a 3.45 MW generation deficit occurs.

name: Scenario F — Fixed-Manual Textbook Verification
summary: Uses fixed manual efficiency mode (0.91 turbine, 0.97 generator) for direct hand-calculation verification of Pe = rho * g * Q * H * eta_t * eta_g.
